children: Triple appointed Ian Schworer as Chief Investment Officer, effective December 31, 2026, as Sajal K. Srivastava notified the company of his resignation as President, CIO and director effective the close of business on December 31, 2026.
President; Chief Investment Officer; Member of Board of Directors
Not disclosed; resignation not due to disagreement with Company on operations, policies or practices
Ian Schworer appointed Chief Investment Officer effective Dec 31, 2026
Successor to Sajal K. Srivastava as Chief Investment Officer

Age 45; >20 years experience in venture capital, investment banking, consulting and engineering; Chief Credit Officer, U.S. at TriplePoint Capital LLC since 2014; former Barclays Capital, Booz Allen Hamilton, Lockheed Martin, Intel; MBA UC Berkeley Haas; M.S. Electrical Eng; B.S. Computer Eng (Virginia Tech)
Board size decreased to seven members from eight effective Dec 31, 2026
